verdict.rationale: Bento's own CLI says it can "manage templates", and its docs describe reusable email templates. That gives some programmatic, non-UI template management, but the only listed template formats are plain text or a drag-and-drop editor. The Liquid-variable evidence covers webhook payloads, not email templates, so it does not transfer. Missing for 10: HTML/MJML template authoring, documented variable substitution in email templates, a template API, version-control/Git workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control

citations.quote: send transactional emails, manage templates, and more
